 Follow Kelsey Grammer, 71, hobbles down red carpet after suffering health issue
 Rebecca Lewis Fri, November 13, 2026 at 9:55 PM UTC 4 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. US actor Kelsey Grammer speaks during a "Trump Accounts Tour" event in Westlake Village, California, on May 29, 2026. "Trump Accounts" are savings account for children that grow tax deferred. (AFP via Getty Images) The 71-year-old made the rare red carpet appearance at the Under the Stars Gala at The Beverly Hilton on November 12, 2026, full of smiles despite the boot. Kelsey Grammer has appeared on the red carpet in a medical walking boot and wrist support, days after he revealed that he is considering a run for office.
 The 71-year-old made the rare red carpet appearance at the Under the Stars Gala at The Beverly Hilton on November 12, 2026, full of smiles despite the boot.
 The Frasier star was one of the guests of honor at the annual gala that fundraises to provide dental care for underserved children and young adults throughout Los Angeles
 Kelsey Grammer is seen at the Under the Stars Gala at The Beverly Hilton (@ Getty Images)
 Kelsey, who is a longtime friend of President Donald Trump, confirmed earlier in November that he was considering a run for President of the United States.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "I've been thinking maybe it's time — we'll see," he told Katie Pavlich on NewsNation.
 Kelsey with Katie Cassidy (@ Getty Images)
 In June, he visited President Donald Trump in the White House for a private meeting after which he reportedly "left with a big bag of swag, including hats and a Bible," according to Deadline.
 "I know we're all divided, and all that nonsense, but I don't put much stock in all that. America is 'America the beautiful' for a reason, and it's got a lot to do with what's in our hearts as well as what's in our landscape," Kelsey told Katie.
 Kelsey attends a visit by President Trump at the Nassau County Police Academy Center for Training and Intelligence (@ AFP via Getty Images)
 The longtime motorcycle enthusiast narrates a new documentary, Call to Action: America the Beautiful, that takes viewers into some of the country's most majestic places including the Redwood Forest and the Badlands.
 Advertisement Advertisement "There's nothing quite like this place. I choke up when I think about it. I love this land so much," he said, before comparing the animals of the Everglades to a lot of the "people in Congress."
 Kayte and Kelsey in 2019 (@ Dave Benett/Getty Images for ATG)
 His wife, Kyte, was not in attendance at the Gala, staying at home with their one-year-old son Christopher ; Kelsey is dad to daughter, Spencer, with his first wife, Doreen Alderman; second daughter, Greer, with then-girlfriend, Barrie Buckner; and daughter Faith, sons Gabriel and James, and baby Christopher with wife Kayte.
 " You forget what a blessing it is to have a small child in your life ," he said in 2025, weeks after Christopher's birth.
 You may also like
 Kelsey Grammer called out by ex-wife after he forgets their daughter's birthday 
 Advertisement Advertisement "Things are less important than you think they are when you're younger, and some things are more important, like quality time with the kids, that's something that's really important," he shared.
 Kelsey added: "When you're a young man, you try to carve out your niche, you know, your place where you can take care of enough family and become the man you want to be, but that can be pretty time consuming."
 Kelsey with daughter Mason and ex-wife Camille in 2006 (@ Getty Images)
 However, Kelsey has also had an up-and-down relationship with his older children , and in October he was publicly critizised by ex-wife, Camille Grammer, after she accused him of forgetting their daughter Mason's 25th birthday on October 24.
 The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills alum, who was married to the Fraiser star from 1997 to 2010, wrote a lengthy post on Instagram, claiming Kelsey has pushed Mason "to the sidelines."
 Advertisement Advertisement "A daughter should never have to wonder whether her father remembers her birthday. Three days later, and still not a call or a text," Camille began. "You can be a beloved actor to the world, but being a father is a role that requires showing up when the cameras are off. Fame, accolades, and public admiration mean very little if you neglect the people who should matter most."
